## What changes and why

<!-- Describe the change and the problem it solves. -->

Closes #

## Type of change

- [ ] `feat`: a new feature
- [ ] `fix`: a bug fix
- [ ] `docs`: documentation only
- [ ] `test`: adding or changing tests
- [ ] `refactor`: code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature
- [ ] `chore`: tooling, configuration or maintenance
- [ ] **Breaking change**: existing behavior or vault data is not backward compatible

## How it was tested

<!-- Describe the tests you added or ran, and the platform you tested on. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] The branch name follows the `feat/...` or `fix/...` convention.
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits and are in English.
- [ ] `npm test` passes, and new or changed behavior is covered by tests.
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run format:check` and `npm run typecheck` pass.
- [ ] Cryptographic code, if any, uses audited libraries and has tests with
      test vectors and failure cases.
- [ ] No new dependency, or the new dependency is justified above.
- [ ] No network connections or telemetry were added.
- [ ] Documentation comments and related docs are updated.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated under `Unreleased`, if the change is visible to
      users.
- [ ] No secrets, keys, real passwords or real data are included.
